default_panel.description: Panel name to open by default when launching budgie-control-center without arguments. Must be one of the documented panel identifiers (e.g., 'background', 'network', 'power').

excluded_panels.description: List of panel names to hide from the overview UI. Does NOT disable CLI access to those panels.

overview_on_startup.description: Whether the overview (main panel menu) is shown on startup, instead of the last viewed panel.

restore_last_session.description: Whether to restore the last open panel and tab on next launch. Overrides DefaultPanel when true.

search_term.description: Initial search query string to pre-fill in the overview search bar; empty means no pre-fill.
